prompt: Write a one-star review of the Grand Canyon from a visitor who feels it was too big.
response:
**★☆☆☆☆ — Way too big, would not recommend**

I don't know who was in charge of planning the Grand Canyon, but they seriously overdid it. I've been to canyons before. This one is absurd.

We drove all the way out here expecting a nice, manageable hole in the ground. Instead? It just goes on and on. And on. You look one way—canyon. You look the other way—MORE canyon. Where does it end? Nobody could tell me. I asked a park ranger and he just smiled like that was somehow a good thing.

The depth is another issue. You can't even see the bottom properly. What's the point of a view if I have to squint and imagine the rest? A responsible attraction would have a floor you can actually see. This felt like they ran out of budget halfway down and just gave up.

Also, way too much walking involved to get around it. If it were, say, one-tenth the size, I could've seen the whole thing in about twenty minutes and been back at the car with time for lunch. Instead we spent the whole day and still only saw a fraction of it. Terrible use of my time.

The colors were fine, I guess. Nice oranges. But you can get those on a nice throw pillow without driving to Arizona.

Do yourself a favor and visit a smaller canyon. Two stars would've been possible if they'd just scaled it back. As is: too big. One star.
